description: MFA step-up gate (#173). ONE golden, TWO stacks: TS `isMfaGateBlocking` (packages/shared/src/mfa.ts, asserted by tests/security/mfa-gate-fixtures.test.ts) and C# `Tims.Domain.Identity.MfaGate.IsBlocking` (asserted by Tims.UnitTests/Identity/MfaGateFixtureTests.cs). The two asymmetric directions are the whole point and both are pinned below: the FLAG fails OPEN (a misconfigured env must never lock privileged users out) while the LEVEL fails CLOSED (once enforcement is on, an unknown level is never good enough).

cases.name: enforcement off — never blocks, even for a privileged aal1 session
enforcement off — not blocking even with a null level
enforced + privileged + aal1 — BLOCKS (the whole point of the gate)
enforced + privileged + aal2 — allowed, the session stepped up
enforced + privileged + NULL level — fail-CLOSED, blocks
enforced + privileged + unknown level — fail-CLOSED, blocks
enforced + privileged + empty-string level — fail-CLOSED, blocks
enforced but NOT privileged — ordinary staff are never gated
enforced, not privileged, null level — still not gated

enforcedFlag.name: 'TRUE' does NOT — exact match only, mirroring RLS_ENFORCED

privileged.name: hr_admin is NOT in the privileged set
